what: On first open, the textured panel covering the Hero rests .5s, then shrinks inward by 58px on all sides over .5s to become a frame. At .7s, background-colored triangles that cut 50px off the two top corners of the panel slide in over .5s. Pieces inside the panel (text·images) switch on in a set order (.1s apart) from 1.7s over .2s, and late pieces (people·copy) switch on at 2.4s over 1s. At 3.2s the whole panel settles downward over .5s ease-in-out, revealing the large wordmark behind it.

options.drop: Drop distance (css length), default calc(9.5vw + 166px) — 0 means no drop
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Plate that rounds the corners (hides overflow) — frame only if absent
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Pieces that light up in turn inside the panel. Change the order (from 0) with data-order — if absent, placement order

use: Phrase
note: When it lands, the panel moves down by drop, so leave a bottom margin of drop on the section above the panel so the header behind it (position: fixed wordmark) shows in that spot. It is a curtain that makes people wait, so its length is exposed as an option — on screens opened often, at: 0.; Reduce to start: 0

from.where: index.css .cb-hero·.cb-kv — original body.load #hero::before 58px .5s ease .5s, .hero_kv::before/::after 50px triangle -118px→0 .5s ease .7s, letter imgs at 1.7·1.8·1.9·2·2.1·2.2s for .2s, people and copy 1s ease 2.4s, #hero top calc(9.5vw + 166px) .5s ease-in-out 3.2s
